reason: Fix the review batch B1/B2/B3/E3 on top of the uncommitted worktree at HEAD daff700. B1: the native Host Program read-only check now compares the storage bytes of the actually bound input instead of C float values, so an unchanged NaN is not a false positive and -0.0->+0.0 or any other bit-pattern rewrite is refused. B2: the expected ABI and per-input snapshots moved out of candidate-writable dylib statics into harness-owned buffers whose addresses are call arguments, so the snapshot is no longer a static a candidate can name; this is not an in-process memory sandbox and the external worker boundary is unchanged. B3: guard verification now reads the guard band of the actually bound store (the Metal shared buffer for a directly bound input, with its real 16 KiB margins and pattern) and runs before any span commit; a directly bound input without a guard descriptor is refused instead of falling back to the unbound static region, and the outer V2ArgSet GuardedBuffer negatives remain. E3: taic/trust.py registered _host_probe_command, _sweep_command, _ab_command and _feedback_check_command, which render TASK.md command text; the prompt sha1 moves from 9b2345d9 to 25d2e428 so existing grants become stale_prompt, as intended. The code closure stays at 79 files and moves from c1aba6e6 to 0034486a because tcenv/hostprogram/native_abi.py is in the task-pack closure. No trust file was re-signed and no grant scope was widened.
